description: This file declares the class AdbLegacyIOCompletion, which encapsulates a wrapper around the Windows OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous I/O operations in the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) legacy USB API. It defines constructors, destructor, and methods to handle overlapped I/O results, along with member variables for internal state.

classes.name: AdbLegacyIOCompletion
classes.description: Encapsulates a wrapper around OVERLAPPED Win32 structure for asynchronous USB I/O, providing methods to retrieve operation results and manage state related to legacy USB endpoint I/O.

methods.name: AdbLegacyIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the I/O completion object with parameters such as parent endpoint, expected transfer size, event handle, and I/O type (read/write).

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyIOCompletion
methods.description: Protected destructor to prevent direct stack allocation, ensuring proper heap management.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an overlapped I/O operation using GetOverlappedResult, indicating whether the operation has completed.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject * parent_legacy_io_object() const
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the parent legacy endpoint object associated with this completion.

methods.name: bool is_write_ioctl() const
methods.description: Indicates whether this completion is for a write operation.

methods.name: ULONG * transferred_bytes_ptr()
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the number of bytes transferred in a write operation.
